pipeline_name: El Tina-Abu Sultan-New Administrative Capital Gas Pipeline

validity.recommendation: no change to existence/classification/status/diameter/cost; see separate spec concern on Length
validity.researcher_notes: EXISTENCE test applied: full-text search of the sheet's own already-cited sources, both of which name this exact 3-point pipeline by name. (1) https://petro-news.com/95212/ (already the Status/Fuel/PipelineType [ref], Oct 2024, 'petronews' Egyptian oil-and-gas trade outlet), item 12 of a 39-project roster: 'انشاء خط غاز التينة - ابو سلطان - العاصمة الادارية ... يعد الخط 42 بوصة واجمالي اطوال 165 كم بمحافظة القاهرة، الاسماعيلية، وبورسعيد، بتكلفة 3 مليار و335 مليون جنيه' (construction of the El Tina-Abu Sultan-Administrative Capital gas line ... the line is 42in and total length 165km across Cairo, Ismailia and Port Said governorates, cost EGP 3,335 million). (2) https://www.youm7.com/story/2020/1/2/.../4570084 (already the Start/ProjectLevelCost [ref], Jan 2020, Youm7 - major Egyptian daily), reporting the Petroleum Ministry's 2019 year-in-review: 'خط غاز التينة/ابو سلطان/العاصمة الادارية «المرحلة الاولى والثانية» بطول 165 كم وقطر 42 بوصة ... وتبلغ التكلفة الاستثمارية للمشروع حوالي 3335 مليون جنيه، وتم تشغيله في يوليو 2019' (the El Tina/Abu Sultan/Administrative Capital line, phases 1+2, length 165km diameter 42in ... investment cost approx EGP 3,335 million, put into operation July 2019). Two independent Egyptian outlets (a trade press site and a national daily), five years apart, both naming this exact pipeline and agreeing on diameter, cost and an operational (not proposed/cancelled) status -> this is a real, built, operating pipeline, not a GEM-only/hallucinated entity. CLASSIFICATION: both sources describe it as a national-gas-grid reinforcement line feeding power-station consumers (New Administrative Capital, and per Youm7 also Beni Sweif) - a transmission trunk, matching GEM's PipelineType=transmission and Fuel=Gas. STATUS: 'operating' is not a literal substring in either source (hence the automated verifier's FAIL on Status/PipelineType/Fuel checks against petro-news.com is a documented content false-negative, not evidence of a problem) but is confirmed by inference: petro-news frames it as one of '39 مشروعا نفذتها الدولة المصرية' (39 projects the Egyptian state HAS IMPLEMENTED) 2014-2024, and Youm7 explicitly states 'تم تشغيله في يوليو 2019' (was put into operation July 2019). DUPLICATE check against the 40-row roster: Abu Sultan is a hub node on the GASCO national-grid map (EGAS Annual Report 2018, printed p.35) where several distinct GEM rows converge - P8033 (Ain Sokhna-Abu Sultan), P8036 (Mit Nama-Abu Sultan P.S.), P8074 (Abu Sultan-El Shabab) - but each runs a different corridor/direction off that hub; P8002 is uniquely the corridor running south-west from Abu Sultan toward Cairo/New Administrative Capital (visible on the map as two parallel green lines labelled 42in-165km and 32in-106km). No duplicate found.

validity.recommendation: correct Length from 73.00 km to 165 km (keep Diameter=42in and ProjectLevelCost=3,335,000,000 EGP, both independently confirmed); re-point Length [ref] to the two sources below since the currently-cited EGAS AR2018 PDF does not actually support 73km
validity.researcher_notes: SPEC test applied: read the CURRENTLY CITED source for Length (EGAS Annual Report 2018 PDF, egyptoil-gas.com) on its own terms, since the scope note warns some of these 40 rows were identified visually off the GASCO national-grid map on printed p.35 of that same report rather than from its body text. I located printed p.35 (PDF page 19 of the 36-page report) and rendered it at 400dpi. It IS the GASCO map. Tracing the corridor from the 'El-Tina' node south through 'Abu Sultan' to 'New Capital P.S.', the map itself labels this corridor '42"-165km' and, on a second parallel line over the same stretch, '32"-106km' - there is no '73km' label anywhere near this corridor (the closest visually similar figure on the whole map is an unrelated '42"-74km' line feeding 6 October City near Cairo, a different pipeline entirely). So the sheet's own cited source, read correctly (map, not just text-search), gives 165km for the 42in line - not 73km; GEM's current Length value is not supported by its own citation. INDEPENDENT CORROBORATION (2 sources, matching each other and the map): both petro-news.com/95212/ and the Youm7 2020 story (see the existence finding above - the same two URLs already sit in this row's own [ref] cells for other fields) explicitly state, in nearly identical language, 'خط غاز التينة/ابو سلطان/العاصمة الادارية (المرحلة الاولى والثانية) بطول 165 كم وقطر 42 بوصة' (El Tina/Abu Sultan/Administrative Capital line, phases 1+2, length 165km, diameter 42in). A third, older primary source - the Ministry of Petroleum's own 'مشروعات الشبكة القومية للغازات الطبيعية' PDF (petroleum.gov.eg), preserved via Wayback capture 20210924151457 (the live URL now serves a different, newer edition of the same-titled document and 404s on this content, but the archived Feb-2021 edition is intact and readable via pdftotext) - independently states the same figure: 'خط غاز التينة/اﺒو سلطان/العاصمة الادارية (المرحلة الاولى والثانية) بطول 165 كم وقطر 42 بوصة'. That capture would not pass url_verifier.py cleanly in this session (ConnectTimeout through the script's default requests session; it DOES return 200 with the expected PDF bytes via a longer-timeout direct fetch), so it is not included in proposed_refs, but it is a real, readable, independent confirmation Baird may want to add by hand. Net: 3 independent sources (2 cleanly verified) converge on 165km/42in against 0 sources found for 73km; the ProjectLevelCost value already staged (3,335,000,000 EGP) is also confirmed by both verified sources (written out as '3335 مليون جنيه' / '3 مليار و335 مليون جنيه' in the prose, which is why the automated substring check against the digit string failed - a content false-negative, not a wrong value) and needs no change.

summary: P8002 confirmed real, operating, correctly classified (2 independent Arabic sources naming it directly, no duplicate found among the Abu Sultan hub's other rows) but Length is a material SPEC error: staged 73.00km is unsupported by its own EGAS-AR2018 citation (whose own p.35 map actually reads 165km for this line) and is contradicted by 3 independent sources (2 verified) that all say 165km/42in; recommend correcting Length to 165km. No UNRESOLVED items.
